sets.actual: Man sits on floor with knees up; woman stands/bends behind him with hands on his shoulders. She is not seated on his lap and not back to him.
Standing, body turned away, head turned back over shoulder, one hand on hip, legs crossed slightly.
Standing, feet together, both arms straight overhead with hands together.
Standing, one hand behind head, other hand on hip, weight shifted.
Standing, one hand at chin/neck, other arm lowered at thigh, legs crossed.
Standing, both arms behind the back, chest forward, feet together.
Standing on one leg; other knee lifted and bent with foot tucked behind the standing leg. Thigh comes forward rather than a clear lift behind.
Standing wide stance, both hands on hips.
Standing, one arm raised, other hand on hip, hip pushed out, legs crossed.
Standing, both hands clasped behind the neck, elbows out.
Standing mid-step, one hand raised to forehead, other arm down and out; hair itself not drawable on mannequin.
Standing on tiptoe, both arms raised in a V.
Kneeling upright; front view arms hang slightly out, diag/side hands rest on thighs.
Kneeling upright, both hands behind head, elbows out.
Half-kneeling on one knee, hand resting on raised knee.
Kneeling, torso arched back with head dropped back, hands on lower legs (camel-like).
Kneeling upright, both arms stretched straight up.
Kneeling, one hand on top of head, other hand on hip.
Half-kneeling with hand on knee; head only slightly raised, looking up not clearly shown.
Kneeling, torso leaning sideways, one hand on floor, other arm raised; side view is more upright.
Kneeling upright, both hands on hips, chest forward with mild arch.
Kneeling, hips shifted, one arm raised high, other hand on hip/thigh.
Seated on floor, hands behind head; front view knees together flared thighs (W-like), below view shows one knee up, legs not clearly W-sit.
Seated on floor leaning back on hands behind; knees up with legs forward in diag/side, not a clear W-sit.
Seated with legs bent and swept to one side, one hand on knee, other hand on floor.
Seated on floor, legs folded to side, one hand on cheek, elbow on knee.
Seated side-sit, legs folded to one side, one arm propped on floor, other arm stretched up.
Seated cross-legged (criss-cross) with one hand at neck/chin; not a W-sit or side sit.
Lying on back with both arms stretched overhead; side view shows torso somewhat raised.
Lying on side, head resting on hand, upper arm on hip, legs extended.
Lying face down propped on forearms, knees bent with feet kicked up.
Semi-reclined/sitting propped on one arm with BOTH knees raised; side view is nearly seated upright, not lying on back with one knee raised.
Lying on side, head on arm, waist slightly curved, legs stacked and extended.
